Whether you're recovering from an ischemic stroke, a hemorrhagic stroke, or supporting a loved one through rehabilitation, this podcast gives you what most doctors can't: ➡️ Real-world recovery stories ➡️ Emotional support and mindset tools ➡️ Insights into post-stroke neuroplasticity and healing ➡️ Actionable advice for stroke recovery at home Each episode explores what it truly takes to reclaim your independence, mental well-being, and sense of purpose after stroke. From managing fatigue and mobility challenges to navigating relationships and emotional setbacks — we go there.
